notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Book will close when you die on the computer instead of staying open and allowing you to type still.

- When you die while typing, the correct scene will load.

- Audio from the computer will not play when not in use.

notes.title: Bug/Enemy fixes
notes.notes:
- Objectives are less vague so story progression is easier

- Enemy AI path has been reconfigured

- Console loads correct scene

- Night 2 enemy repositioned for smoother transition

- Night 3 enemy positioned in different location to provide context on mechanics and so the player doesn't die almost instantly.
